messages:
Nina: Heads-up: saw a small but consistent p95 uptick for very short requests after last night's selector tuning. Hosts in pool-E only. Dash snippet: https://dash.redwood/pool-E/p95 :mag_right:
Carlos: timeline? any batch hist or kvcache signal?
Nina: running_batch_p50 shifted 3 -> 1.8 on affected hosts. kvcache remote-fallback rate up ~2%. grpc writev smallframe count +12%.
Devon: sample trace (trimmed):
```
2025-03-14T03:12:01.210 parse_request   0.6ms
2025-03-14T03:12:01.211 tokenize        3.2ms  (unicode-normalize pass)
2025-03-14T03:12:01.215 kvcache_lookup  0.5ms (miss -> remote fetch 4.2ms)
2025-03-14T03:12:01.220 kernel_exec     17.6ms  (chosen: fused_vector)
2025-03-14T03:12:01.238 grpc_writev     4.8ms  (4 small frames)
```
Carlos: looks like selector now prefers fused_vector for this model-shape. That kernel improves long-seq throughput but increases per-request CPU for tiny seqs -> lower effective concurrency -> smaller arrival batches -> worse kvcache locality -> more remote fetches -> extra smallwrites. A classic feedback loop.
Nina: We need a short-term gate + telemetry and a longer-term change to selector scoring.
Devon: Proposals: 1) soft-rollback canary selector config on pool-E (infra-bot), 2) emit per-host metric kernel_variant and running_batch_size_hist + kvcache_remote_rate + grpc_smallwrite_count, 3) add a lightweight gating rule: if running_batch_p90 < 3 prefer scalar_light kernel.
Carlos: also: include a host_side_cost estimate in kernel scoring: host_preproc_est (parse+tokenize) + expected_network_cost (estimated smallwrite count * syscall-cost) + kernel_exec_ms. Right now selector only uses kernel token throughput numbers.
Nina: agreed. Devops: can we enqueue a replay (3k tiny reqs) against the canary to reproduce and to run the sidecar-tokenize sim?
perf-bot: Replay job created: replay/1767713141-3k-32t. Link: https://replay.redwood/jobs/1767713141 ETA ~5m. Will attach traces when done.
infra-bot: Soft-rollback requested. Applying selector:canary -> previous-policy on pool-E. ETA ~60s.
deploy-bot: Soft-rollback initiated at 03:20:40 UTC.
Carlos: For the sidecar experiment: co-located tokenization sidecar removes tokenize CPU from host, but adds RPC overhead and additional smallwrite/writev on sidecar path. Need end-to-end sim numbers. Add it as an A/B in the replay.
Devon: For observability, I'd like a new derived metric: per-host kernel_cost_estimate = kernel_exec_ms + median_tokenize_ms + avg_smallwrite_syscalls_cost. Emit that with kernel_variant label so we can tune selector thresholds.
Nina: Good. Also add preflight CI micro-benchmark: a lightweight replay (2k tiny reqs) run for any selector config change. Fail rollout if running_batch_p50 drops >1 and kvcache_remote_rate increases >1%.
perf-bot: Replay finished. Delta confirmed on canary group: p95 +6% with fused_vector. Attaching trimmed spans to the RFC thread.
infra-bot: Rollback complete at 03:22:05 UTC. Pool-E metrics trending to baseline.
Nina: Closing the immediate alert. Next steps (tracking): A) RFC for selector scoring change (include host_preproc+network cost), B) implement gating rule and emit telemetry, C) CI preflight replay job, D) sidecar simulation experiment. I'll open RFC and link replay artifacts.
Carlos: small note: also consider tuning gRPC coalesce thresholds on hosts (writev batching) to reduce syscall count for tiny responses; might mitigate some network amplification without touching kernels.
Devon: agreed, include gRPC smallwrite coalescing in the experiment matrix.
Nina: Thanks all :thumbsup:
